How a foreign traveler goes from search to payment

Solid boxes are the main path. Dashed boxes are optional checks the traveler can use in any order before booking.

StepWhat happensDoubt removed
1. DiscoverLands from a Xiaohongshu post, search or a friend's postcard; switches to 中文; opens a tour"Unclear how to book"; "what is included"
2. Check and decideOptional: trip builder, concierge in Chinese (hand-off to a manager if unsure), Trust Center with guide video and a 5-minute call"Is this company trustworthy?"
3. BookThree short steps with clear inline errors; price summary repeats Included and Not-yet-confirmed items"Unclear how to book"
4. Pay, travel, shareProvider-hosted card checkout; declined payments can be retried; confirmation code; trip timeline; postcard with referral link"My foreign card does not work"
